children: EQS-Media / 09.09.2026 / 16:48 CET/CEST
MUNICH, Germany

EP Cube, the residential energy storage and management brand under Canadian Solar, today announced the launch of the EP Cube EV Charger in Europe, in a strategic partnership with European AC & DC charging infrastructure leader KEBA. Powered by KEBA's proven charging technology, the new solution is a reliable, easy-to-install EV charger built for full integration into the EP Cube smart home energy ecosystem, enabling homeowners to charge smarter, reduce energy costs, and maximize the value of their solar investment.
After connecting with the new EP Cube EV Charger, users can easily manage and customize their EV charging preferences directly from the EP Cube App.

"Our partnership with KEBA enables us to deliver a reliable, fully integrated EV charging solution that addresses the growing need for smart home energy management," said Andy Yin, Founder and CEO of Canadian Solar EP Cube. "We are empowering our customers to maximize their clean energy investments and take full control of their energy usage." “E-mobility and home energy management must work as one reliable system,” says Stefan Richter, CEO of KEBA Energy Automation. “By combining EP Cube’s intelligent energy ecosystem with KEBA’s proven charging technology, we are enabling homeowners to make better use of their solar energy and charge their vehicles more efficiently. This partnership brings together complementary strengths to deliver a seamlessly integrated solution designed for everyday use.” The EP Cube EV Charger is available in two power variants. The
11 kW three-phase model
is planned for release across European markets by the end of September 2026, while the
7.4 kW single-phase model
is planned for release in Q4 2026.
One Connected System for Greater Energy Independence

Powered by KEBA, the new EP Cube EV Charger ensures full integration with the EP Cube platform via local Ethernet. The system allows homeowners to optimize their energy consumption and reduce costs through a suite of intelligent features. The PV Surplus mode prioritizes excess solar energy to charge the vehicle, maximizing solar self-consumption. Users can also leverage the Scheduled Charing mode and Dynamic Tariff integration to charge during off-peak hours or when energy rates are low. For times when speed matters, Plug-and-Play mode begins charging the moment the vehicle is connected, or a Fast Charging boost can be activated during any active charging session to deliver maximum power when an immediate top-up is required. By fully integrating EV charging with solar generation, battery storage and home energy management, the EP Cube EV Charger enables homeowners to increase solar self-consumption, reduce electricity costs, and enjoy a simpler, more efficient home energy experience through a single integrated platform. About EP Cube

EP Cube is a residential energy storage brand built around a simple belief: home energy should be human-centric, safe, and designed for long-term value. First launched in 2022, EP Cube creates flexible, intelligent, all-in-one home energy storage and management systems, helping households store solar energy, stay protected during outages, and take greater control of energy costs while supporting the global energy transition. EP Cube is developed and manufactured by Eternalplanet, an independent brand of residential energy storage technology under Canadian Solar Inc., and is supported by a growing ecosystem of local partners and installer communities across multiple markets.
About KEBA

Since 2009, KEBA eMobility is a leading manufacturer of AC & DC charging solutions with a strong track record of reliable, certified hardware deployed across residential, commercial, and public charging applications globally.
